name: Otero County, CO
findings: Otero County has 98 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Otero County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Otero County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.
